product_metadata.title: 48-Pack Hawaiian Luau Party Supplies, Oval Paper Plates (12.5 x 10.5 in)
features: SERVES 48: Includes 48 party plates; add to the dining table setting, or use them at the buffet and dessert table
HAWAIIAN PARTY DECORATIONS: The oval paper plates feature colorful flowers and leaves, ideal for creating a celebratory atmosphere and a perfectly coordinated theme for your Hawaiian luau party
QUICK AND EASY CLEAN UP: An ideal alternative to traditional plastic party plates, simply dispose of paper plates set after use; no need to stop the fun to clean up
HIGH QUALITY: Made from heavy-duty paper, these sturdy paper plates will not break or fold while carrying food
DIMENSIONS: Floral paper plates measure approximately 12.5 x 10.5 inches in diameter
description: Make a statement with this decorative party plate set that is ideal for a Hawaiian Luau party. Add these plates to your summer bash and impress your guests with a cohesive theme throughout your event. Spend more time celebrating and less time cleaning up. Disposal is a hassle-free task with these party paper plates! Warning. Do not Microwave.
